task:
Open OBS Studio and create a podcast recording setup with four scenes.

1. OBS may start with a default 'Scene' -- delete it.
2. Create four scenes with the exact names: 'Solo', 'Dual', 'Screen Demo', and 'Intermission'.
3. Select the 'Solo' scene and add these two sources:
   a. A Video Capture Device source named exactly 'Host Camera'.
   b. A Color Source named exactly 'Solo BG'.
4. Select the 'Dual' scene and add these two sources:
   a. A Video Capture Device source named exactly 'Host'.
   b. A Video Capture Device source named exactly 'Guest'.
5. Select the 'Screen Demo' scene and add these two sources:
   a. A Display Capture (or Screen Capture) source named exactly 'Shared Screen'.
   b. A Text (FreeType 2) source named exactly 'Topic'. Set the text to any value.
6. Select the 'Intermission' scene. Add an Image source named exactly 'Break Slide'. Set its file path to /home/user/Pictures/break.png.
7. Make sure all sources are visible (eye icon enabled) in all scenes.
8. Remove any extra default scenes. The collection should have exactly 4 scenes.
9. Close OBS or let it auto-save.

verification.description: Source 'Shared Screen' exists in 'Screen Demo' scene
